functions.name: generate_vision
functions.title: Generate AI-Assisted Vision
functions.description: Takes a rough business idea and returns a fully articulated vision with target market, core capabilities, scale scope, and success metrics. Use when the user describes what they want to build but needs help articulating it.

raw_idea.description: The user's rough business idea or vision description

functions.name: generate_strategies
functions.title: Generate 10 Business Strategies
functions.description: Takes an approved vision and generates 10 distinct strategies with business names, domain suggestions (with live availability checking), target cities, monetization models, and recommended agents. Use when the user has an approved vision and needs actionable strategies.

functions.name: build_agent_fleet
functions.title: Build Agent Fleet from Vision
functions.description: Analyzes a vision and generates a complete agent fleet with master prompts, capabilities, actions, and project structure. Use when the user has a strategy and wants to auto-generate all agents needed to operate the system 24/7.

action.description: 'analyze' to get recommendations, 'generate' to create agents, 'launch' to validate

recommended_agents.description: Required for 'generate' action — the agent recommendations from 'analyze'

functions.name: run_dominance_campaign
functions.title: Run Digital Dominance Campaign
functions.description: Launches and executes a digital dominance campaign: branding, domain, infrastructure, content flood, persona fame, SEO, and AI search optimization. Use when the user wants to deploy a website with full SEO and content automation.

action.description: 'launch' to start, 'status' to check, 'list' to see all campaigns

functions.name: orchestrate_system
functions.title: Orchestrate System Operations
functions.description: Unified entry point for system health checks, agent activity monitoring, auto-healing, and running any operation. Use for system status, health checks, self-healing, and delegating commands to the right subsystem.

action.description: 'health' for system status, 'activity' for agent activity, 'heal' for auto-repair, 'operate' to run a command

functions.name: scan_competitors
functions.title: Scan Competitors for SEO
functions.description: Researches competitors in a niche and location, identifying their pricing, services, strengths, gaps, and backlink opportunities. Use when the user needs competitive intelligence for SEO strategy.

functions.name: analyze_industry_trends
functions.title: Analyze Industry Trends
functions.description: Analyzes trade industry growth using real BLS employment and wage data with deterministic projections. Use when the user needs industry forecasting and growth analysis.

action.description: 'analyze' for specific industry, 'industries' to list all

functions.name: validate_system
functions.title: Validate System Readiness
functions.description: Runs the AutoComplete convergence cycle to validate system benchmarks, identify gaps, and auto-repair issues toward VERIFIED_100 status. Use when the user wants to check or improve system production readiness.

action.description: 'status' for current state, 'cycle' to run validation, 'full_cycle' for complete convergence

functions.name: inspect_twilio_connection
functions.title: Inspect Twilio Voice Connection
functions.description: Read-only check of the approved Twilio account or Eden Skye number ending 1174. Does not call, text, purchase, record, or change routing. Live voice remains UNKNOWN until tested.
